title: 第21章 魔法之神第22章 我们都在走向那个未来
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 几乎是一瞬间，艾伦便意识到面前的人是谁。
白发，年轻的面孔，这特征组合在艾泽拉斯可不多见。
大法师卡德加。
那位在守护者麦迪文手下做学徒的年轻法师，在杀死麦迪文的过程中，因为麦迪文的诅咒魔法一夜白头。
为什么自己总能在酒馆碰上一些大人物，他们就这么爱喝酒吗？
还没等他开口套近乎，白发年轻法师突然伸出手，一把抓住艾伦的手腕，猛地翻开！
他低着头，目光死死盯着艾伦的手腕内侧，仿佛在寻找什么痕迹。
然而，他什么也没看到。
“啊！你弄疼我了，先生！”艾伦痛呼出声，用力往回抽手。
白发年轻法师抬起头，盯着艾伦的脸看了几秒，目光中闪过一丝困惑。他讪讪地松开手，语气有些尴尬：“抱歉抱歉，我认错人了。”
艾伦揉着被捏红的手腕，“好吧先生，我原谅你了。那你能回答我的问题吗？”
白发年轻法师挑了挑眉，脸上浮现出一个狡黠的笑容，
“我没见过你说的那个人。但是......我很擅长占卜。如果你能给我一个金币，我就能帮你占卜出他的方位。”
艾伦愣住，倒反天罡了，诈骗到我的头上来了？
行。
我让你见识见识什么叫真正的诈骗。
艾伦的表情瞬间垮了下来。他的眼眶开始泛红，嘴唇微微颤抖，整个人像是被抽走了所有的力气。
“先生……”他的声音哽咽了，“您有所不知……”
白发年轻法师的笑容僵住了。
艾伦抬起眼，那双眼睛里已经蓄满了泪水，在昏暗的油灯下闪闪发光：
“我们家……是奥特兰克的没落贵族。曾经也算是显赫一时，可战争一来，什么都没了。我的妹妹，小艾米……”
他吸了吸鼻子，泪水顺着脸颊滑落。
“她从小就想当法师，做梦都想。她那么聪明，那么努力，好不容易进了暴风城的法师塔当学徒。可是……可是我们家太穷了，连学费都交不起。她已经好几天没吃饭了，可她还是咬着牙坚持学习……”
“我没办法，只能到处接悬赏，什么活都干。这次追查的通缉犯，赏金是我妹妹继续学习的唯一希望。如果找不到他，如果拿不到赏金……”
他哽咽得说不出话来，低下头。
然后，他抬起泪眼朦胧的脸，小心翼翼地从怀里掏出一块翠绿色的石头。
“先生，这是我身上最值钱的东西了，一块孔雀石，我能用它来支付您的占卜费用吗？”
「欺瞒检定：20点，大成功」
「卡德加无比确信，你就是那个人，但奇怪地是，你的手腕上没有那个痕迹，所以，即使他有百分之九十九的把握，他也不敢肯定，所以，他选择了相信你」
那个人？
艾伦心中一动。系统说的“那个人”是谁？什么手腕上的痕迹？
卡德加摇了摇头，取出法杖。
“算了。”他说，“你这块孔雀石虽然不够我进行占卜的——”
他顿了顿，嘴角勾起一个笑容：
“但可以交换一个祝福。”
他举起法杖，嘴里念出一串咒语。
艾伦感觉周围的空气开始流动。
蓝紫色的奥术能量从卡德加的法杖顶端涌出，在他周身盘旋、缠绕。
它缓缓渗入艾伦的身体。
能量最终汇聚到艾伦的头顶，在那里凝聚成一个虚幻的蓝色眼睛，那眼睛缓缓睁开，俯瞰着下方的艾伦，然后又缓缓闭合，消散在空气中。
【你获得了增益效果：奥术智慧】
【智力+100，持续时间：24小时】
content_en:
;;
Almost instantly, Allen realized who the person in front of him was.
White hair and a young face, this combination of features is rare in Azeroth.
Archmage Khadgar.
The young mage who was an apprentice under the guardian Medivh, in the process of killing Medivh, lost his head overnight because of Medivh's curse magic.
Why do I always meet some big shots in pubs? Do they love drinking so much?
Before he could get close, the white-haired young mage suddenly stretched out his hand, grabbed Allen's wrist, and opened it suddenly!
He lowered his head and stared at the inside of Allen's wrist, as if looking for some trace.
However, he saw nothing.
"Ah! You hurt me, sir!" Allen cried out in pain and pulled his hand back hard.
The white-haired young mage raised his head and stared at Allen's face for a few seconds, a trace of confusion flashing in his eyes. He let go of his hand and said in an awkward tone: "Sorry, sorry, I recognized the wrong person."
Allen rubbed his pinched wrist, "Okay sir, I forgive you. Can you answer my question?"
The white-haired young mage raised his eyebrows, and a sly smile appeared on his face.
"I have never met the person you are talking about. But... I am very good at divination. If you can give me a gold coin, I can help you divine his location."
Allen was stunned. It turned out to be Tiangang. Did he deceive me?
OK.
Let me show you what a real scam is.
Allen's expression fell instantly. His eyes began to turn red, his lips trembled slightly, and all the strength seemed to have been drained from his whole body.
"Sir..." His voice choked, "You don't know something..."
The white-haired young mage's smile froze.
Allen raised his eyes, which were filled with tears and sparkled under the dim oil lamp:
"Our family... is a declining noble of Alterac. It was once prominent, but when the war came, everything was gone. My sister, little Amy..."
He sniffed, tears falling down his cheeks.
"She has wanted to be a mage since she was a child. She has always dreamed of it. She is so smart and hard-working, and she finally entered the mage tower in Stormwind City as an apprentice. But...but our family is too poor and can't even pay the tuition. She hasn't eaten for several days, but she still gritted her teeth and insisted on studying..."
"I have no choice but to accept bounties everywhere and do anything. The bounty for the wanted criminal I am tracking this time is my sister's only hope to continue studying. If I can't find him, if I can't get the bounty..."
He was so choked that he couldn't speak and lowered his head.
Then, he raised his tearful face and carefully took out an emerald green stone from his arms.
"Sir, this is the most valuable thing I have, a piece of malachite. Can I use it to pay for your divination?"
"Deception check: 20 points, great success"
"Khadgar is extremely convinced that you are that person, but the strange thing is that there is no mark on your wrist, so even if he is 99% sure, he is not sure, so he chose to believe you."
That person?
Allen's heart moved. Who is "that person" the system is talking about? What marks on your wrist?
Khadgar shook his head and took out his staff.
"Forget it." He said, "Although your piece of malachite is not enough for me to perform divination——"
He paused and a smile appeared on his lips:
"But a blessing can be exchanged."
He raised his staff and uttered a spell.
Allen felt the air around him begin to move.
Blue-purple arcane energy surged from the top of Khadgar's staff, swirling and entwining around him.
It slowly seeped into Allen's body.
The energy finally gathered on top of Allen's head, where it condensed into an illusory blue eye. The eye slowly opened, overlooking Allen below, and then slowly closed and dissipated in the air.
